name: Mushroom and lentil breakfast plate
description: A savoury soy-free breakfast plate: sliced mushrooms seared hard in dry pans, folded through warm cooked lentils and wilted spinach, finished with sunflower seeds and fresh dill.
instructions: Set two wide non-stick pans over high heat, divide the mushrooms between them in a single layer and leave them undisturbed for 3 minutes so they brown rather than steam.
Stir once, add the salt, and cook for 3 minutes more until the pans are dry again.
Divide the lentils between the pans and warm them through for 2 minutes, pressing them lightly into the surface.
Fold in the spinach a large handful at a time and cook for 2 minutes, just until it collapses.
Divide between two plates, then scatter the sunflower seeds and the dill over the top.
